scope: Targeted incremental audit only. The previous 743-check full audit is not repeated. No changed assumptions or production-engine import.
method: Independently compute DCAI sales times the added margin of 0.003 per year from 2031, capped at 0.03 from 2040. Apply the unchanged cash-tax rate, discount the incremental cash and 3% terminal stream, and add the actual 2031 retained-cash increment once. All other operating cash fields, financing tax benefits, debt and claims are checked unchanged.
controls: 2027–2030 operating profit, tax, cash and treasury are unchanged.
Physical capex, D&A, working capital, lease/minority costs and incentives remain unchanged for every modeled year.
The supplied baseline and host policy still match the hashes from the prior independent audit.
The fixed debt and nonbinding tax-capacity convention leave financing tax shields unchanged.
Higher 2031 cash is counted in the 2031 endpoint balance; post-endpoint operating PV begins 2032, so that cash is not counted twice.
interpretation: Arithmetic verifies implementation of the 35% DCAI margin judgment; it does not empirically establish that margin, the 12% rate or market convergence. The adjustment raises group profit once without a second Foundry benefit.
competition_implication: Agree with withdrawing the presumptive 3–5-year SHORT. The preferred model now gives 60.86 in 2029 and 67.58 in 2030 versus the dated 58.11 entry. The early 44.07 end 2026 planning reference supports a current-value counterview only if root separately owns an earlier repricing forecast. It does not establish a passive-short payoff or force a LONG recommendation. This is a changed preferred forecast, not a demand for perfect foresight.
supersedes: The provisional-short preference in independent_intel_server_ASP_mix_audit_and_direction.json is superseded for competition selection by this targeted update; that earlier arithmetic audit remains valid for its preserved source.
